chunks: And Zurārah asked Abā Jaʿfar عليه السلام about:
a man performing the nawāfil prayers on a ship.
He said: “He should pray toward its front.”

key_terms.أَبَا جَعْفَرٍ: Abū Jaʿfar, Imam al-Bāqir عليه السلام
key_terms.زُرَارَةُ: Zurārah, the narrator asking the Imam

ai.seo_question: How should a person perform nawāfil prayer on a ship?
ai.summary: This hadith gives a legal ruling concerning nawāfil prayer while aboard a ship. Imam Abū Jaʿfar عليه السلام instructs that the person should pray facing toward the front of the vessel, showing practical guidance for worship during travel.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.1324 – Zurarah asked Imam Muhammad ibn Ali Al-Baqir (as) about
a man performing supererogatory (nafilah) prayers on a ship.
Imam (as) said: "He should pray in the direction of its front (bow)."
